title: Trump ordered to sit for deposition in $10 billion BBC lawsuit

copy.headline: A US judge ordered Trump to sit for a deposition in his $10 billion BBC defamation lawsuit by December 11.
copy.explainer: A deposition means answering questions under oath before trial. The judge also warned the case could be thrown out if a dispute over records is not resolved.

caption:
A US judge has ordered Donald Trump to sit for a deposition in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC.
He must answer questions under oath by December 11.
The judge also warned the case could be tossed in a fight over records.
Should a sitting president have to testify in civil cases like this one?

source: AP News, Al Jazeera, Axios
